newsitem.title: USA: Coastal names Scott interim president/CEO.
newsitem.headline: Coastal names Scott interim president/CEO.

text.p: Coastal Physician Group Inc said it has named Steven Scott as president and chief executive for an interim period, effective March 1.
The company said Henry Murphy has notified its board that he will not extend his employment as Coastal's interim president and CEO beyond its scheduled expiration of February 28.
It said Murphy will continue as a director.
Scott, Coastal's chairman of the board, said the company will take approrpriate actions to identify and engage a permanent president and chief executive.
